# Lavendar Lewis

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed 45  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P48](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0048)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P0](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0000)</sub>
- **Family:** [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Lavendar Lewis is a little lady with an almost girlish face, marked by pink, pretty cheeks, sweet lips, and dimples. She has big, sweet, wood-brown eyes containing golden glints, alongside pretty hands. Her hair is snow-white, thick, and naturally wavy, which she wears carefully arranged in becoming puffs and coils.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P25](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0025), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P34](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0034), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029)_

## Personality

Lavendar Lewis copes with life by engaging in imagination and play-acting. She has stated that she does not believe she could endure certain times without pretending things.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)_

## Traits

- likes to pretend things  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)</sub>

## History

Miss Lavendar Lewis, named by her father due to his fondness for lavender, lived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with her maid, Charlotta the Fourth. She had previously been engaged to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) when young, but their relationship ended after a silly quarrel. Years later, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) stumbled upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where Miss Lavendar hosted them for tea and was visibly shaken to hear of Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md). Miss Lavendar later confided the details of her broken engagement to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who eventually introduced [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) to her, leading to a quick bond between the two. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brought Stephen's message offering to visit, Miss Lavendar excitedly prepared for his arrival, resulting in their joyful reconciliation and eventual marriage at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), +21 more_

## Quotes

> "But oh, won’t you stay and have tea with me? Please, do. Mr. Kimball’s will have tea over before you get there. And Charlotta the Fourth and I will be so glad to have you."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)

> "I love them myself. They are very good company . . . with a little pretending. On calm evenings Charlotta the Fourth and I often sit out here and amuse ourselves with them. Charlotta, take back the horn and hang it carefully in its place."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074)

> "It gave me a shock to hear about Stephen’s son that first day you were here, Anne. I’ve never been able to mention him to you since, but I’ve wanted to know all about him. What sort of a boy is he?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "Oh, I’m not so old as I thought . . . and I don’t need a single blue pill! Girls, when you come back with your strawberries we’ll have tea out here under the silver poplar. I’ll have it all ready for you with home-grown cream."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P36](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0036)

> "I’m wholesomely ashamed to think that a new dress . . . even it is a forget-me-not organdy . . . should exhilarate me so, when a good conscience and an extra contribution to Foreign Missions couldn’t do it."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P19](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0019)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Miss Lavendar become very dear friends and kindred spirits after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stumbles upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) in the woods. Miss Lavendar confides the story of her past romance to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who later introduces her to [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and facilitates her reunion with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +6 more_

- Friend of — very dear friend and kindred spirit  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P31](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0031)</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta the Fourth serves as the handmaiden at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) under Miss Lavendar's command. She cares deeply for her employer, confiding her concerns about Miss Lavendar's melancholic mood to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and later observing Miss Lavendar's joyful romantic reconciliation alongside her.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +11 more_

- Commands — employer/master to handmaiden  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)</sub>

### [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

Miss Lavendar and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) were previously engaged twenty-five years earlier before their romance was broken off. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers a note from Stephen, he visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), leading to their joyful reconciliation and eventual marriage in a wedding ceremony at her home.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022), +4 more_

- Romantically involved with — formerly engaged twenty-five years ago  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
